shared_elements: standing/frontal human-like figure occupying the whole surface
head with elaborate headdress or cap
low-relief carving on a tall upright slab-like stone
incised details on chest and lower body
justification: Both depict a single tall frontal anthropomorphic figure filling an upright monolithic surface, with a distinct headdress above and arms folded/held across the chest, plus incised ornament on the torso — a fairly generic monumental-figure scheme. They differ substantially in specific form and convention: A is a three-dimensional statue with a broad rounded body, curvilinear chest motifs (concentric rings, crescent) and no clear limbs or attributes, while B is a flat relief showing a figure in near-profile head with detailed costume, a held object and a subsidiary animal/figure at the lower right, and framed panels — features absent in A.
